description: This Java source file defines the SimpleWikiHelper class, which provides helper methods for interacting with the Wiktionary API. It includes functions for preparing a User-Agent string, fetching page content, handling HTTP requests, and parsing JSON responses. The class is designed to facilitate lightweight API communication, requiring external dependencies such as Apache HttpClient and org.json libraries.

classes.name: SimpleWikiHelper.ApiException
classes.description: Custom exception for errors during API communication.

classes.name: SimpleWikiHelper.ParseException
classes.description: Custom exception for errors during parsing API responses.

methods.name: prepareUserAgent
methods.description: Initializes the User-Agent string based on the app's package name and version.

methods.name: getPageContent
methods.description: Fetches and returns the content of a specified Wiktionary page.

methods.name: getUrlContent
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request to the given URL and returns the response content.
